name: FUN_IN_INGESTION_ERRORS
description: This table stores errors that have occurred during ERP inbound flows.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Code of the error that was encountered.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.description: Error message corresponding to the error code.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the application that owns the inbound flow. It refers to a seeded subledger or Accounting Hub subledger defined by the user.

columns.name: PROGRAM_CODE
columns.description: The process name in which this error is encountered. This will come from a lookup.

columns.name: ERROR_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Error category associated with the error code.

columns.name: ERROR_NUM
columns.description: Number of occurrences of the error code for a particular run identifier.

columns.name: JOB_RUN_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of inbound process that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_PACKAGE
columns.description: Indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ERROR_DETAIL_CHAR1
columns.description: Additional supporting information that can be used for reporting and error correction. Contents of this column will vary depending upon the error code.
